notes.title: October 22nd Update (Achievement Explanation)
notes.content: Hello, this is Play Mephistowaltz. Many of you have asked about the achievements for Faint Memory and Truth. These achievements are set for the 4th clear and 10th clear. For players who have already completed the game but didn't receive the achievements due to a bug, we've updated the game so you will automatically receive them when you start the game again. Enjoy playing on Road 8!

notes.title: Update
notes.content: An update has been made for convenience and to make the game even more enjoyable. You'll be able to experience the charm of Route 8 even more.
